original_record.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: Authentic standard Mech Arena Juggernaut, stocky blue protective combat chassis with recognizable bulky upper frame, compact source sensor/head and original two-legged construction. Preserve source model proportions. One short-range emitter mounted on one source weapon hardpoint; opposite protection represents ONE equipped shield, other mounts empty. Grounded defensive stance, no shield bubble or human pilot.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #119 slot 1 Juggernaut.
original_record.visual_review: Accepted: complete framing, distinct chassis, shared collection lighting and finish

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Mech Arena  
**Strategy:** Squadron · **Target roster:** 6 robots  
**Opening:** 3 robots · **Hard cap:** 6 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `arena-systems-consortium`

**Proposed robots:** Juggernaut; Ares; Guardian MA; Killshot; Panther; Zephyr.

**Source edition:** Standard base models of Juggernaut, Ares, Guardian, Killshot, Panther, and Zephyr. Preserve chassis identity rather than importing game balance values or special skins.

**Naming:** Guardian MA uses the source alias Guardian and avoids the already-authored Roboquest robot named Guardian. The other five use source machine designations.

**Backstory:** The Consortium fields a protected opening trio and spends its next contracts on mobility and precision. Six specialist chassis make a complete arena squadron, with every machine assigned to a pair and a trio.

**Purchasing personality:** Killshot completes the second pair. Panther and Zephyr complete the second trio and the final pair. Keep equipment spending balanced across all six after recruitment.

**Robot blueprints**

| Slot | Arena robot name | Source identity | Joins | Arena role | Loadout | Stance / yield | Build_Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Juggernaut** | Juggernaut | Opening | Defensive anchor | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 20% | Warden |
| 2 | **Ares** | Ares | Opening | Protected line shooter | `weapon_shield` | balanced / 20% | Tactician |
| 3 | **Guardian MA** | Guardian | Opening | Heavy line shooter | `two_handed` | offensive / 15% | Bruiser |
| 4 | **Killshot** | Killshot | Growth #1 | Close assault | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Sprinter |
| 5 | **Panther** | Panther | Growth #2 | Precision support | `single` | balanced / 15% | Deadeye |
| 6 | **Zephyr** | Zephyr | Growth #3 | Mid-range covering fire | `single` | defensive / 20% | Tactician |

**Weapon paths** — stage 0 on recruitment, then stage 1. Prices are combined list-price equipment subtotals, not total robot or stable purchase costs.

| Slot | Range from weapons | Stage 0 | Stage 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 2 | mid | Bolt Carbine + Combat Shield (₡171,000) | Nova Caster + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 3 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 4 | short | Scatter Cannon (₡84,000) | Arc Projector (₡488,000) |
| 5 | long | Beam Pistol (₡93,000) | Particle Lance (₡425,000) |
| 6 | mid | Bolt Carbine (₡93,000) | Nova Caster (₡425,000) |

**Equipment planning totals:** opening trio ₡329,000; recruits 4–6 at stage 0 ₡270,000; all six at stage 1 ₡3,414,000; 8 equipped weapon/shield items at the six-robot target. The stage-0 equipment component of the slot-5-and-6 recruitment reserve is ₡186,000, plus both robot frames, required facilities, and maintenance reserve.

**Refinement plans — after all six robots reach stage 1**

Execute each row from left to right. Costs and workshop gates for every operation are in the [shared refinement rules](#squadron-refinement-rules). Main/offhand targets are explicit; all six robots have a non-empty plan.

| Slot | Robot | Ordered refinement steps | Refinement subtotal |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | **Juggernaut** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |
| 2 | **Ares** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Nova Caster: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Nova Caster: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡950,000 |
| 3 | **Guardian MA** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 4 | **Killshot** | Main Arc Projector: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Arc Projector: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 5 | **Panther** | Main Particle Lance: Hone Targeting Systems 8→10 → Main Particle Lance: Augment Weapon Control +3 (new) → Main Particle Lance: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Particle Lance: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 6 | **Zephyr** | Main Nova Caster: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Nova Caster: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |

**Refinement budget:** ₡5,570,000 across six robots. Final stage-1 equipment plus refinement totals ₡8,984,000; stage-0 purchases and facility, frame, training, and maintenance costs are additional.

**Portrait blueprints** — show one complete body using the shared art direction. Signature features identify the source; every active weapon or shield must map to the equipment allocations above.

| Slot | Portrait and equipment brief |
|---|---|
| 1 | Use the standard Juggernaut model, retaining its stocky protective frame and original leg arrangement. One short weapon and one shield item; readable defensive pose. |
| 2 | Standard Ares source body with its recognizable frontal shield presentation. One mid-range weapon plus shield; source barrier ability is represented only by equipped arena gear. |
| 3 | Use the standard Guardian chassis and characteristic source head and torso. One heavy mid-range weapon; no system-crash, EMP, or opponent-control mechanic is granted. |
| 4 | Preserve the low, agile Killshot source chassis and its original locomotion geometry. One heavy short-range weapon; the dash is a pose cue rather than an added movement ability. |
| 5 | Standard Panther body with the source proportions, head, and weapon mounts. One long-range arena weapon; keep any source barrier effect out of the mechanical blueprint. |
| 6 | Use the standard Zephyr model and recognizable sensor details. One mid-range weapon in a guarded pose; source electrical effects do not add a stun. |

**Named teams and fixed membership** — all names are original Armoured Souls team labels.

| Format | Team name | Fixed members | Forms |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2v2 | **Bastion Protocol** | 1 Juggernaut + 2 Ares | Opening trio |
| 2v2 | **Breach Circuit** | 3 Guardian MA + 4 Killshot | When slot 4 joins |
| 2v2 | **Crossfire Signal** | 5 Panther + 6 Zephyr | When slot 6 joins |
| 3v3 | **Iron Formation** | 1 Juggernaut + 2 Ares + 3 Guardian MA | Opening trio |
| 3v3 | **Rapid Response** | 4 Killshot + 5 Panther + 6 Zephyr | When slot 6 joins |

**Shared parameters:** apply the Squadron recruitment, fixed-team, event-order, budget, tuning, refinement, and image rules below. Slots 1–3 open together; buy 4, then 5, then 6. No reserve slots or substitution alternatives are included.

References: [official Mech Arena reference](https://mecharena.game/), [official Guardian discussion](https://mecharena-support.plarium.com/hc/en-us/articles/29729519481628-Don-t-Sleep-on-the-Classics-A-High-Energy-Blueprint-for-Guardian-Paragon-and-Puma-by-SkandaBT), [secondary six-model identity reference](https://mecharena.wiki.gg/wiki/Mechs).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3. Recruit slot 4, then fund the complete slot-5/slot-6 pair before buying 5 followed by 6. Finish all six final loadouts before refinement. Invest in slot order 1,4,2,5,3,6, with Hone, Augment, first Sharpen and first Forge passes through Workshop L1, L3, L5 and L8. Keep funding and prestige-gated steps pending.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, upkeep, repair costs, discounts and resale. Alternatives excluded.
